goal: Real Isaac ForkliftB actuates its lift_joint (prismatic, world +Z) to +0.5m. Proves a referenced articulated robot + pre-configured joint drive actuate. ForkliftB has no usable fork tines (workflow-grounded) so the proof is the lift_joint DOF rising, not a load on tines.
thoughts: Forklift-build workflow grounded the rig: lift_joint raises the cab+mast (no fork tines exist on ForkliftB). Proof = scene_eyes-logged lift_joint DOF rising 0->~0.5. Path /World/Forklift/lift_joint (add_reference maps default prim onto the referencing prim).
code:
# CP-FORK-01 (cont.319ee): real Isaac ForkliftB ACTUATES ITS LIFT (lift_joint prismatic, world +Z) — proves a
# referenced articulated robot + a pre-configured joint DRIVE actuate. ★Grounded surprise (forklift-build workflow):
# ForkliftB has NO usable fork tines (the forward "tine" bbox = 680k phantom unused verts; only liftable collider =
# the operator cab; lift_joint raises the WHOLE cab+mast). So NOT a box-on-tines load-lift; the proof = the
# lift_joint DOF rising, which scene_eyes already logs per 0.1s. A real pallet-on-tines lift needs a tine-equipped
# asset (ForkliftC / Props/Forklift) -> CP-FORK-02.
create_prim(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", prim_type="DomeLight")
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", attr_name="inputs:intensity", value=1000.0)
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Ground", prim_type="Cube", position=[0, 0, -0.5], scale=[20, 20, 1])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Ground", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
set_physics_scene_config(config={"enable_gpu_dynamics": False, "broadphase_type": "MBP"})

# Reference the real ForkliftB (keeps its articulation + the configured lift drive). Default prim /SMV_Forklift_B01_01
# maps ONTO /World/Forklift (the conveyor precedent: a referenced default prim becomes the referencing prim), so
# lift_joint lands at /World/Forklift/lift_joint (NOT a nested SMV_* path).
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Forklift", prim_type="Xform", position=[0.0, 0.0, 0.0])
add_reference(prim_path="/World/Forklift", reference_path="/mnt/shared_data/isaac-sim-assets-complete-5.0.0/Assets/Isaac/5.0/Isaac/Robots/IsaacSim/ForkliftB/forklift_b.usd")

# RAISE: set the prismatic drive target to +0.5 m (world +Z). Strong drive (stiffness 1e5) moves it on play.
# limits [-0.15, 2.0] -> 0.5 valid. PROOF = lift_joint DOF in eyes.json rises 0 -> ~0.5.
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/Forklift/lift_joint", attr_name="drive:linear:physics:targetPosition", value=0.5)
extension_notes: CP-FORK-02 = a tine-equipped forklift (ForkliftC / Props/Forklift) lifting a real pallet on tines; CP-FORK-03 = tricycle DRIVE (back_wheel_drive velocity + back_wheel_swivel steer).
